primary: T2 minus B3 at every nonzero budget for each horizon in closed loop. Report T2 minus H-paced on the same grid and both contrasts on the fixed stream.
diagnostics: Compare T2 and T1, T2 and T2-no-NLI, T1 and T1-no-NLI, and the score-by-pacing interaction (T2 minus T2-no-NLI) minus (T1 minus T1-no-NLI). These are policy contrasts, including spend differences.
endpoint: Same six exact-slot accuracy checks as Step 30. Historical accuracy and live before/after target transitions are separate.
trace_selection: First frozen history in each of three strata for chronological T2 versus B3 at 50%, nominal horizon: T2 wins, loses or ties. Show same histories in both modes.
reader_scoring: Count every attempted question. Incorrect, abstained, invalid and contradictory are mutually exclusive failures. A short answer citing multiple distinct slot values is contradictory; a correct short answer cites the expected slot value alone. Use the existing deterministic subtotal contract.
caps: Use Step 30 rotating caps unchanged. Fixed stream is run once because horizon is not used. Nonadaptive closed-loop policies are run once and paired with every horizon.
causality: Horizon values are exogenously supplied constants (2/3/5/7/10), not estimated from actual arrivals. No unknown-horizon arm.
interpretation: Post-hoc robustness on the same 100 synthetic histories. Report all cells. Family intervals are descriptive and uncorrected for multiple testing.
